historical_references.reference: Anishakti, another name for Goddess Parvati, is believed to be the embodiment of divine power or Shakti. The name Anishakti is derived from the Sanskrit words 'anisha' meaning 'beyond measure' and 'kshakti' meaning 'power'. This name emphasizes Parvati's infinite and all-powerful nature.
